pages.text: The $(item)ME Packaging Provider/$ combines the function of the $(l:core/packager)Packager/$ and the $(l:core/unpackager)Unpackager/$.$(p)This machine must be connected to an $(thing)ME Network/$, requiring a channel.

pages.title: Usage
pages.text: To use the $(item)ME Packaging Provider/$, put an encoded $(l:core/recipe_holder)Package Recipe Holder/$ inside. The machine will then provide Direct, Packaging, and/or Unpackaging recipes depending on the settings.

pages.title: Settings
pages.text: $(thing)Direct/$: Provide package recipes as a large processing recipe, skipping the packaging and unpackaging steps.$(p)$(thing)Packaging/$: Provide packaging recipes like a $(l:core/packager)Packager/$.$(p)$(thing)Unpackaging/$: Provide unpackaging recipes like an $(l:core/unpackager)Unpackager/$.

pages.title: Settings Cloning
pages.text: Using the $(l:core/settings_cloner)Packaging Settings Cloner/$, you can copy and paste the providing settings and the current available recipes.$(p)To paste recipes, the target $(item)ME Packaging Provider/$ should not have recipes, and you must have a an $(l:core/recipe_holder)Package Recipe Holder/$ in your inventory.
